scope: First independent non-mining validator/RPC node; optional mining and client-library APIs tracked separately.

gates.title: Rust-only build and runtime boundary
acceptance: Default build/distribution/runtime do not invoke or depend on Go; Go-backed flags are rejected.
Frozen-view compatibility runs without an upstream; output explicitly identifies unverified chain state.

gates.title: Pinned network and fork contract
acceptance: Use the reviewed official v0.57.0 source baseline, keep the archived local fee overlay inactive, and record immutable network/configuration hashes; source selection does not qualify a runtime target.
Pin chain ID, engine(s), prime/region/zone genesis, active hierarchy, fork rules and height contexts, activation schedule and protocol/resource limits.
Declare initial target and known checkpoint; a checkpoint does not bypass native validation of downloaded blocks.
Fill and qualify a separate target manifest; no unresolved null/placeholder values may enter a live configuration.
gates.partial_scope: Official allocation data imported into a native height-indexed asset; 28 allocation-root comparisons include Singularity and Polaris forfeiture changes. Private chain 1337 source/config/genesis remain pinned. Public target and complete initialization qualification remain open.

gates.title: Full protocol schemas and bounded wire decoding
acceptance: Implement complete work-object header/body/views, transactions, receipts, auxiliary forms and network request/response/gossip envelopes.
Cross-client encode/decode/error/unknown-field tests match the selected profile; qualify maximum accepted values from the actual protocol.
Reject oversized/truncated streams and malformed nested messages within bounded CPU/memory; preserve required canonicalization and routing rules.
Track typed-RLP decoding for raw-transaction RPC in parallel; network work-object transport is Protobuf.
gates.partial_scope: All raw schemas; bounded complete work-object reconstruction. Full semantic domains/auxiliary forms/limits remain open.

gates.title: Complete block and commitment verification
acceptance: Recompute every applicable block/header/body/transaction/receipt/uncle/ETX commitment for the selected fork context.
Compare accepted and rejected real complete blocks against the oracle, including auxiliary forms, multi-block batches and commitment mutations.
Define empty/nonempty encodings, ordering, duplicate handling and integer boundaries; do not treat existing bounded header hashes as full block validity.
gates.partial_scope: Native branch-bound token-choice windows now preserve exact 4000-entry Go warmup, rollover, signed correction rounding and rate feedback. Native state transactions persist changed rows and metadata atomically, with fork/root binding and malformed/recovery rejection. The explicit supplied pre-controller seed does not establish canonical ancestry. Negative final difficulty and full controller/admission integration remain open. Runtime profiles and disk formats are unchanged; full consensus and public canonical sync remain unfinished.

gates.title: Serial execution and economic state transitions
acceptance: Execute Quai custom EVM opcodes, precompiles, gas, access-list rules, fees/rent, scope/address rules and forked fee features from identical pre-state.
Execute Qi ownership/signatures, UTXO spends/creation, double-spend rejection, fees, locks, conversions and hierarchy ETX effects.
Account/UTXO/ETX commitments, receipts/log order and multiplicity, gas, fees, rewards and emitted ETXs agree for before/at/after every relevant fork.
Full replay includes rejected blocks/transactions and long histories. A Rust EVM library is a component, not automatic Quai compatibility.
Keep execution serial until equivalence is established; later parallelism must validate all account, UTXO and ETX conflicts deterministically.
gates.partial_scope: Native branch-bound token-choice windows now preserve exact 4000-entry Go warmup, rollover, signed correction rounding and rate feedback. Native state transactions persist changed rows and metadata atomically, with fork/root binding and malformed/recovery rejection. The explicit supplied pre-controller seed does not establish canonical ancestry. Negative final difficulty and full controller/admission integration remain open. Runtime profiles and disk formats are unchanged; full consensus and public canonical sync remain unfinished.

gates.title: PoW, auxiliary validation and hierarchy fork choice
acceptance: Validate supported ProgPoW/KAWPOW/SHA BTC/SHA BCH/Scrypt donor proofs, merge-mining commitments, coinbase/Merkle rules and auxiliary-template quorum signatures.
Match header/workshare/uncle rules, difficulty/entropy, PoEM fork choice, expansion, rewards and prime/region/zone ordering at declared fork boundaries.
Use competing branches, invalid proofs, malformed shares and cross-context vectors; imported PoW/reward validation is mandatory even for a non-mining node.
gates.partial_scope: Native branch-bound token-choice windows now preserve exact 4000-entry Go warmup, rollover, signed correction rounding and rate feedback. Native state transactions persist changed rows and metadata atomically, with fork/root binding and malformed/recovery rejection. The explicit supplied pre-controller seed does not establish canonical ancestry. Negative final difficulty and full controller/admission integration remain open. Runtime profiles and disk formats are unchanged; full consensus and public canonical sync remain unfinished.

gates.title: Durable validated canonical state
acceptance: Atomically publish head, account/UTXO/ETX state, receipts, indexes and availability as one coherent generation.
Reorg/rollback, restart, interrupted commits, snapshots and pruning preserve exact roots and request-consistent generations.
Recover from injected crashes at commit boundaries without publishing partial or stale validated state.
Use a native schema with explicit migrations; direct reading of Go database files is optional and separately qualified.
gates.partial_scope: Native branch-bound token-choice windows now preserve exact 4000-entry Go warmup, rollover, signed correction rounding and rate feedback. Native state transactions persist changed rows and metadata atomically, with fork/root binding and malformed/recovery rejection. The explicit supplied pre-controller seed does not establish canonical ancestry. Negative final difficulty and full controller/admission integration remain open. Runtime profiles and disk formats are unchanged; full consensus and public canonical sync remain unfinished.

gates.title: Controlled Rust-Go peer interoperability
acceptance: On an isolated lab network, interoperate on peer identity, Noise/transport/mux negotiation, identify, DHT discovery, connection/resource management and explicit private bootnodes.
Match /quai/1.0.0 streams, four-byte big-endian length prefix, location/request correlation, genesis/location/type topics and selected GossipSub rules.
Exercise real header/block requests, gossip and auxiliary messages plus oversize, timeout, disconnect, invalid-peer and backpressure cases.
Until execution/consensus gates pass, all received content is unverified and cannot establish canonical authority or validated RPC.
gates.partial_scope: Optional Rust libp2p 0.56.0 Noise/Yamux persistent-stream transport with enrollment, IPv4-loopback filtering before TCP, stream/connection/frame limits and poisoned streams after I/O failure. Eight actual Go/Rust request pairs and three early Rust/Rust block deliveries passed; default RPC binaries do not enable transport. Raw object acquisition now exercises 38 requests and four malformed/disconnecting/state-invalid peer cases over actual Rust Noise/Yamux streams. The fixed early profile now passes separate Rust OS-process native peer acquisition/reorg, persistent identity, receiver/source restart, SIGKILL recovery and cancellation. Known heads need no network connection. Explicit source/head control and bounded local histories remain; broad/global/automatic production sync is unqualified.

gates.title: Independent validated private-network sync
acceptance: Start from declared genesis and synchronize over P2P while all canonical decisions are made by native Rust consensus/execution.
Match controlled Go peers on state/UTXO/ETX roots and fork choice across mined/replayed blocks, forks, disconnects, malicious peers and restarts.
Serve only locally validated canonical generations; verify block/body availability and bounded acquisition queues. No Go oracle or gateway at runtime.
gates.partial_scope: Exact native full-header proofs supply weaker inclusion/reward work, under the same immutable verifier and exact bytes. Scope-bound inclusion entries remain separate and cannot populate strong proofs. Native body/state/fork checks are unchanged. Completed qualification includes 8192-block fresh replay/independent-process sync, 96-block direct datadir bridge, a 1024-block live incremental oracle pilot, and a separate 1024-block independent receiver reusing that executed source. No supplied state/checkpoint is imported. The original 259216-block offline oracle and native follower are still active and grant no completed activation qualification. Full ETX/fork/expansion/coordinator/EVM/resource/public sync gates remain open.

gates.title: Public shadow validation
acceptance: Use an explicitly qualified public-network target, including release/fork profile, bootstrap and known checkpoints.
Replay archived fork boundaries and catch up through a declared public height/hash; compare roots, receipts, ETXs and head selection with independent Go observations.
Complete sustained shadow sync, reorg/restart and adversarial-peer drills with persisted divergence reports; do not promote unverified imports.
Record test durations, block ranges, chain contexts, hardware and acceptance thresholds before promotion; no duration/performance result exists yet.

gates.title: Live RPC, wallet and transaction-pool compatibility
acceptance: Discover methods actually exposed by selected modules/transports/context, beyond the current 67 selected candidate methods.
Implement native account/UTXO reads, proofs where promised, calls/estimates/access lists, full receipt/log/filter semantics and WebSocket/subscription reorg behavior.
Validate raw-transaction RLP ingress and externally signed transaction admission, replacement/fees, nonce/UTXO conflicts and bounded pool eviction.
Run both pinned Quais.js variants and Pelagus end-to-end against Rust-owned live state, including errors, reconnects, transaction gossip and mined outcomes.

gates.title: Production RPC canary and whole-client qualification
acceptance: Define and pass sustained Linux block replay/sync/RPC/pool/P2P workload SLOs: correctness, CPU, peak RSS, disk growth, p50/p95/p99 and throughput.
Measure malformed traffic, queue bounds, slow disks/peers, reorgs, crash recovery, pruning and overload behavior with observable availability.
Exercise release/reproducible-build/dependency/license review, operational telemetry, upgrade, rollback, repair and explicit canary expansion criteria.
Publish immutable evidence for a small RPC canary before broad production service; signature microbenchmarks cannot close this gate.

gates.title: Optional mining and remaining compatibility
acceptance: Implement and qualify mining work/template generation, Stratum and any additional Go client/admin/debug APIs promised by the selected product profile.
Track APIs and operating systems excluded from the first non-mining RPC-node target explicitly; never defer imported-block PoW, rewards or hierarchy validation.

promotion_rule: A gate passes only with immutable acceptance evidence and passed dependencies. Documentation and component file counts alone cannot pass a runtime gate.
